queries: WITH per AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS o FROM Laboratory), kept AS (SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, p.avg_hgb - o.o AS above_overall FROM per p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.o) SELECT ID, avg_hgb, above_overall, avg_hgb - (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) FROM kept) AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Patients with no non-null HGB values have no average and are excluded; the overall average is the pooled mean of all non-null HGB records.
The mean of kept patients' averages is computed over all kept patients (not just the top 10), and ties in the sort order are broken arbitrarily.

assumptions.assumption: Patients whose HGB values are all NULL have no average and are excluded; the overall average is the pooled mean over all non-null HGB records.
The kept-patients' mean is the simple mean of the kept patients' per-patient averages (each patient counts once).

assumptions.assumption: Patients whose HGB values are all NULL have no average and are excluded; the overall average is the pooled mean of non-null HGB values across all Laboratory rows.
Ties at the top 10 boundary are broken arbitrarily.
